第26章遇到事情不要慌
新书期数据很重要，看书的朋友记得收藏，另外求推荐票，求投资，拜谢了。

嘭！
房门被人从外面一脚踹开。
十几个提着砍刀的人闯了进来，一眼就落在华十二身上，其中一个喊道：“就是这小崽子，砍死他！”
伴随着陈念的惊叫声，那些人挥舞着砍刀，越过陈念所坐的沙发就朝对面的华十二冲杀过来。
华十二双手一抓，直接将面前的茶几抄了起来，左右横轮，噼里啪啦一顿横扫，那轻飘飘的砍刀在这二十多斤的茶几和他的巨力面前，根本没有任何作用，十几个冲过来的家伙被他连人带刀全都拍躺在地上。
这些人身后一个穿着色半袖体桖衫，满脸横肉的臂中年男人，看到华十二这么能打，眨眼之间就把他带来的小弟全都放趴下了，顿时眼角直跳。
他一眼看见正在尖叫的陈念，顿时心里一动，然后走过去一把抓住陈念的头发，右手一把卡簧直接抵在了这妞的脖子上：
“小崽子你要再敢动手，老子就一刀捅死她！”
陈念的尖叫声已经戛然而止，只是眼角的泪水，和眼中的恐慌，证明她此时心里怕的要死。
轰的一声，华十二将已经有些破碎的茶几扔在地上，这让中年男人露出得意的笑容：“小子，认识我吗？我叫马七，别人给面子叫我一声.，诶，你干什么呢？”
他自报完家门，还没来得及放两句狠话，就见对方从裤袋里掏出一个手机，对着他就是一顿拍。
咔咔咔.
听着不断按动快门的声音，马七都气疯了：“小崽子你真不怕我弄死她是吗？”
华十二拍完马七，然后又对着地上的这些被他打倒的持刀小弟拍了几张，听到马七这么问，当即露出一丝笑意道：
“遇见事情不要慌，先拍照发个朋友圈！”
他说着转过手机给马七看他刚才拍摄的照片，手机屏幕上，马七持刀挟持陈念的画面清清楚楚。
华十二这才说道：

“大名鼎鼎的安桥七爷是吧？知道朋友圈是什么吗？我这朋友圈里一百多人，别看现在你是名震安桥道上的贼王，可只要我这手指一按，将这照片上传朋友圈，你瞬间就变成了挟持人质的绑匪，凶徒，还是证据确凿的那种！”
“要是面前这小丫头有什么三长两短，你就准备跑路一辈子吧！”
其实他朋友圈里哪有一百多人，这么说不过是充场面而已。
“我，艹！”
马七手下就有不少偷手机的，他三天两头换新手机，哪能不知道现在正火的朋友圈是什么！
当即就有一种我是谁，我在哪的感觉，就连平日里的口头语都说不利索了。
他就没想到这个被自己等人堵住，今天就要砍断手脚的这小崽子，竟然弄出这么一出！
怎么这事儿还能这么操作吗？
“把手机交出来，信不信现在我就弄死她！”
马七露出一个恶狠狠的表情，同时手里的匕首晃了晃。
华十二轻咳一声：
“那个，这句话我录音了啊，到时候有照片，有录音，她要出点事儿，你想不死都难！”
“你赶紧动手好了，然后一命偿一命，我发朋友圈了啊，我现在就发了啊，我可真发了啊，我这就发.”
马七咽了咽吐沫：“等等，你.，你到底想怎么样？”
本来是穷凶极恶，想要过来砍人的马七，此时的语气就好像受了委屈的小媳妇一样。
打，打不过，心眼还没人家多，关键这小子都什么路数，这招也太损了吧！
华十二好笑道：“拜托，是你们冲进来又打又杀的，现在问我怎么办，你没搞错吧？”
马七感觉自己思维都乱了，下意识问道：“那我该怎么办？”
此时被挟持的陈念，都被华十二和马七的对话整不会了。
她现在有些想笑，但自己可是人质啊，她有些纠结，若是现在笑场，是不是太不尊重身后的歹徒了。

华十二也觉得有些好笑，问道：
“这么着吧，你把她放开然后离开这里，我就把照片删了，咱们就当这些事情从来没发生过，你是安桥一方老大，我得罪不起，七爷您就高抬贵手，以后也别找我和这丫头的麻烦，你看怎么样？”
马七心里有些犹豫，闷声道：“你打了我的人，还把我几个手下弄进了局子，难道就这么算了？”
华十二指着被踹坏的房门：“那你还踹我门了呢！”
“我去.”

Chapter 26 Don’t panic when something happens

※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
Bang!
The door was kicked open from outside.
A dozen people carrying machetes broke in, and one glance fell on Hua Twelve. One of them shouted: "That's the kid, chop him to death!"
Accompanied by Chen Nian's screams, those people brandished machetes, crossed the sofa where Chen Nian was sitting, and rushed towards Hua Twelve opposite.
Hua Twelve grabbed the coffee table in front of him with both hands and directly lifted the coffee table in front of him. He used the left and right horizontal wheels to sweep across with a crackle. The light machete had no effect at all in front of the more than 20 kilograms of coffee table and his huge strength. A dozen guys who rushed towards him were all beaten to the ground with their knives.
Behind these people was a middle-aged man wearing a colored half-sleeved T-shirt with a fleshy face. Seeing that Hua Twelve was so good at fighting, he put all the younger brothers he had brought down on the ground in the blink of an eye, and his eyes suddenly jumped.
When he saw Chen Nian screaming, his heart suddenly moved. Then he walked over and grabbed Chen Nian's hair, and put a circlip in his right hand directly on the girl's neck:
"Baby, if you dare to take action again, I will stab her to death!"
Chen Nian's screams had stopped abruptly, but the tears in the corners of her eyes and the panic in her eyes proved that she was scared to death at this time.
With a bang, Hua Twelve threw the somewhat broken coffee table on the ground, which made the middle-aged man smile proudly: "Boy, do you know me? My name is Ma Qi, and others call me to save their face... Hey, what are you doing?"
After he introduced himself to his family, before he could say a few harsh words, he saw the other party take out a mobile phone from his trouser pocket and pat him.
Click click click.
Listening to the sound of the shutter being pressed continuously, Ma Qi went crazy: "Baby, you are really not afraid that I will kill her, are you?"
Hua Twelve finished taking pictures of Ma Qi, and then took a few more pictures of the knife-wielding guys on the ground who were knocked down by him. When he heard Ma Qi ask this, he immediately showed a smile and said:
“Don’t panic when something happens, take a photo first and post it on WeChat Moments!”
As he spoke, he turned his phone to show Ma Qi the photo he had just taken. On the screen of the phone, the picture of Ma Qi holding Chen Nian hostage with a knife was clear.
Hua Twelve then said:
"The famous Seventh Master of Anqiao, right? Do you know what a circle of friends is? There are more than a hundred people in my circle of friends. Even though you are now the famous thief king on Anqiao Road, as long as I press my finger and upload this photo to the circle of friends, you will instantly become a kidnapper and murderer holding hostages, and the kind with solid evidence!"
"If there's anything wrong with this little girl in front of you, be prepared to run away for the rest of your life!"
In fact, there are more than a hundred people in his circle of friends, so saying this is just for show.
"Fuck me!"
Ma Qi has many people who steal mobile phones. He changes his mobile phone every two days. How could he not know what is the popular circle of friends now?
Immediately I had a feeling of who I was and where I was, and even my usual spoken language was difficult to express.
He didn't expect that this kid who was blocked by him and others and whose hands and feet were going to be cut off today would actually do something like this!
How come this can still be done like this?
"Hand over your phone, believe it or not, I will kill her now!"
Ma Qi showed a vicious expression and shook the dagger in his hand.
Hua Twelve coughed lightly:
"Well, I recorded this sentence. When the time comes, there will be photos and recordings. If something happens to her, it will be difficult for you to die!"
"Hurry up and take action, then one life for another, I posted it on Moments, I will post it now, I really did, I will post it now."
Ma Qi swallowed and said, "Wait, you..., what do you want?"
He was originally very vicious and wanted to come over and kill him.The human Ma Qi's tone at this time was like that of a wronged little daughter-in-law.
He can't beat him. He's not as smart as others. The key is that this kid can do anything. This move is too damaging!
Hua Twelve said with a smile: "Please, you guys rushed in and beat and killed me. Now you ask me what to do. Are you right?"
Ma Qi felt that his thoughts were confused, and he subconsciously asked: "Then what should I do?"
Chen Nian, who was being held hostage at this time, was distracted by the conversation between Hua Twelve and Ma Qi.
She wanted to laugh now, but she was a hostage. She was a little confused. If she laughed now, would it be disrespectful to the gangster behind her?
Hua Twelve also felt a little funny and asked:
"Let's do this, let her go and leave here, I will delete the photos, and let's just pretend that these things have never happened. You are the boss of Anqiao, and I can't afford to offend you. Master Qi, please show your respect and don't cause trouble for me and this girl in the future. What do you think?"
Ma Qi felt a little hesitant and said in a low voice: "You beat my people and got a few of my men into trouble. Is that the end of it?"
Hua Twelve pointed to the kicked-in door: "Then you kicked my door down!"
"I'll go."
